primary_endpoint: Safety outcomes through approximately 52 weeks: adverse events, abnormal vital signs, laboratory assessments, ECG abnormalities, and treatment-induced anti-drug antibodies/titer.
safety_signal: Adverse events occurred in 16 participants in each cotadutide dose group and 13 on placebo. Serious AEs/deaths: 300 µg, 1/17 affected and 1 death; 600 µg, 0/18 and 0 deaths; placebo, 0/19 and 0 deaths.
